title: TacMap
summary: Field guide — how to use every TacMap Tools feature.

blocks.body:
# TacMap

**Field Guide** for soldiers using the tactical map. This page is about **how to use** each Tools feature. For formulas, resection math, path-clearance sampling, and routing cost logic, open the **Technical** section.

## Quick visual

![TacMap Tools map](/media/diagrams/tacmap-tools.svg)

Open **TacMap** from the MiliNav home screen. Almost every action is under **Tools** (searchable). Overlays also open from the layers shortcut.

> **Overlays** = your layers. **JUPEM** = official encrypted TOPO/OSM packages. Separate menus on purpose.

## How to open Tools

1. Open TacMap.
2. Tap **Tools**.
3. Search by name or keyword (*compass*, *path*, *overlay*…).
4. Use **Back** from submenus.

## Tracks

### Create Track
- **GPS track log** — records movement as you walk.
- **Draw route** — sketch the path by hand.
- **Map library** — open saved tracks / drawings / photos.
- **Stop GPS track** — end an active log.

### Breadcrumbs
Toggle ON/OFF. Drops a point each time you move — a light trail without managing a full track session.

## Plots & reports

### Draw Graphics
Point, line, area, freehand, rectangle. Undo/cancel while drawing. Finished sketches stay on device.

### Control Measures
MIL-STD-2525C control-measure chips (not full unit icons). Search by name/code/SIDC, then place.

→ Full colour/code list: [Control Measures](#/control-measures)

### SPOTREP
Tap ground → remarks → photos → progress log.

### Photo Mode
Pin a GPS-stamped photo at your **current** location.

### Troop Tracking
Coming soon — do not rely on it yet.

## Navigate (field steps)

![Navigation logic overview](/media/diagrams/navigation-logic.svg)

### Compass Mode (FastLock)
Walk to a waypoint, crosshair, or destination. The **destination stays fixed**; the needle updates from live GPS.

### Compass Bearing (Resection)
1. Tap 2–3 known landmarks.
2. TacMap resects your fix.
3. Tap destination.
4. Follow the floating compass.

→ How the math works: [Navigation calculations](#/navigation-calculations)

### Get Directions
Road route A→B. Prefer free OSRM when online; ArcGIS may be a fallback.

→ Cost rules: [Navigation & ArcGIS Billing](#/navigation-and-arcgis-billing)

### Go To Grid
Jump the camera to lat/lon, UTM, or MGRS. Does not start walking navigation by itself.

## Measure & Terrain

### Distance & Direction
Tap A, then B for distance and bearing. Optional rings: 100 m / 500 m / 1 km.

### Can I see it? (LOS)
Observer → target over DEM (offline GeoTIFF preferred). Terrain check only — not fire control.

### Path clearance
Tap start/end. Arc clears highest ground by height **C** (default 50 m). Replay animation available.

→ Sampling & formula: [Path Clearance](#/path-clearance)

### Elevation file
Choose/remove the offline DEM used by LOS and path clearance.

## Map look & JUPEM

### Basemap Style
Satellite / Streets / Topographic / OSM under your layers.

### Overlays
Offline overlays, grid lines, imported graphics, Map Library, import battle graphics, GeoPDF/GeoTIFF, MBTiles/TPK, download map area.

### JUPEM files
Download/decrypt TOPO or OSM (including SD ZIP) → **Activate Map** to employ the MMPK basemap. Legacy Nav Map opens the classic screen.

→ Paths: [Storage Paths & Decryption](#/storage-paths-and-decryption)
